FEEDBACK: Make nltl:flangeMaterialIncludedInShearArea an explicit single boolean decision on each applicable calculation case (sh:minCount 1 and sh:maxCount 1), and enforce that a true value is permitted only when the relevant structural member has nltl:flangeFitted true. The current optional unconstrained boolean lets the flange-inclusion decision be absent and incorrectly permits inclusion for an unfitted flange.

Locate and use the canonical relationship that pairs each calculation case with its relevant structural member. Replace the current SPARQL condition, which permits nltl:flangeMaterialIncludedInShearArea true whenever any structural member on the same ship has nltl:flangeFitted true, with a constraint requiring the structural member paired to that calculation case to have nltl:flangeFitted true. The existing explicit single boolean decision on each calculation case is correct and must be retained.
